description:
Rotate Rings is two weeks old, already at 1M DAU and 500–600K downloads a day. The twist: the core mechanic was a UA creative first. Century Games ran rotating-ring fake gameplay for a year, Tasty Travels used it as a minigame, and now Nebula (Felix's "good authority" says Hungry Studio, the Block Blast team) turned the ad into the game. No timer, no fail state, "another Arrows," and still only $45–50K/day in ads because interstitials are delayed Block Blast-style: Jakub hit level 34 without one. 3,000 creatives in three weeks, AI IQ-test guys, Einstein, sunglasses to hide the AI eyes. UA is 70% of the success, and the clones are coming.

⏱️ TIMESTAMPS
00:00 – Why the traffic isn't pristine
01:37 – A UA creative became a game
03:08 – Gameplay: rotate, disconnect, shatter
08:20 – 1M DAU in two weeks
11:04 – Hungry Studio's delayed-interstitial playbook
14:32 – Creatives: AI hooks, 3,000 ads, 90 playables
23:12 – $50K/day verdict and clone prediction
